message.content: It’s hard to pick just one, but many critics and audiences crowned **“Parasite”** (2019) as the standout film of 2020—especially after it won Best Picture at the Oscars in early 2021. Its sharp social satire, genre‑blending storytelling, and masterful direction by Bong Joon‑ho made it a cultural touchstone that resonated worldwide. If you’re looking for something else, “Tenet,” “Soul,” or “The Trial of the Chicago 7” also received widespread acclaim.
